# Bounded PPML separation primers shared by
#   crates/fereg-oracle/tests/ppml_separation_primers.rs (public native fit) and
#   tests/python/test_ppml_recession_cone_primers.py (exact-rational cone oracle).
# Each [name] block lists space-separated rows. `regressor` and `effect` may
# repeat. `methods` uses the public names fe, simplex, ir. `dropped` and
# `reasons` (public drop-reason codes) are the native final drop set; `cone`
# is the first-round recession-cone set over intercept, regressors and every
# FE level dummy. `simplex_cells` optionally caps the simplex tableau.

effect = 0 0 1 1 2 2
methods = fe
drop_singletons = 0
dropped = 0 1
reasons = 9 9
cone = 0 1

methods = simplex
drop_singletons = 0
dropped = 0
reasons = 10
cone = 0

outcome = 0 1 0 0 1
effect = 0 0 1 1 1
effect = 0 0 0 1 1
methods = fe ir

dropped = 2

# Rows 2 and 3 already lie in the original cone; the native chain reaches them

cone = 0 2 3
